lines.speaker: milo
lines.text: Why did nobody answer my message in the group chat?

lines.speaker: milo
lines.text: All six of you saw it?

lines.speaker: june
lines.text: Seven. Your mom's in there now.

lines.speaker: milo
lines.text: Then why did nobody say anything?

lines.speaker: june
lines.text: Someone reacted with a thumbs up.

lines.speaker: milo
lines.text: I asked if anyone could help me move.

lines.speaker: june
lines.text: Exactly. The thumbs up means good luck.

lines.speaker: june
lines.text: It was a very supportive thumbs up.

lines.speaker: milo
lines.text: Who even sent the thumbs up?
